entities.summary: Daniela Adrija Vismane is an inactive tennis player from Latvia. She has career-high WTA rankings of 228 in singles, achieved on 16 May 2022, and No. 161 in doubles, achieved on 24 June 2024. On the ITF Circuit, she has won four titles in singles and 11 in doubles.
